items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: a friend of mind, Mike Karoub... my friend Mike Karoub and I, like I said, we were pals

ctx.x: Yeah, kind of. And I had good teachers who knew that that was a good thing for me, to push me as far as testing my limits and putting me in more challenging territory. And I guess it was seventh grade when a friend of mind, Mike Karoub, who is a cello player and bass player, his father was the junior high band director, where I grew up, and his father had gotten him into this group called the International Youth Symphony, which was basically, I was about the youngest guy in it. It was like junior high through…
I didn’t know that that was still required from trumpets — that they’d do that kind of thing.
